units.source_text: 老家阳光充足，但是，在一年之中的11月、12月，即使是万里无云的晴朗日子，一天也要下四五次阵雨。

en.t: My hometown was blessed with abundant sunlight, but in November and December, even on clear days without a cloud in the sky, four or five showers would fall in a single day.

units.source_text: 我的变化无常的情绪，可能就是在这块土地上培养起来的。

en.t: My changeable moods were probably nurtured in that land.
